coordinateSpace: Original independent 2D tissue-section X_spatial coordinates; no registration to other sections or to the adult reference brain.
coordinateUnits: Source X_spatial units; the array does not declare a physical unit.
pointEncoding: Flat triples [gridX,gridY,categoryIndex]. Source-coordinate bin center = origin + (gridXY + 0.5) * pitch. One shared x/y pitch preserves aspect ratio.
downsampling: For each occupied regular-grid bin retain the anatomical category containing the most cells. Ties use source category order. Empty bins remain empty. This is a point-cloud summary, not a tissue boundary segmentation.
selectionRule: Only categories whose selectable flag is true may trigger region selection. NA and missing annotations are neutral context.

rowAlignment.method: AnnData obs categorical codes and obsm rows share the same observation axis; counts verified equal.
